2\. A damaged block restores an old lead 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
STATE_BLOCK can treat a later fence as the missing closing fence, and read_block accepts the
first parseable matching block even if it is a quoted copy below the real one. After an outside edit
damages either fence, an old lease copied into mission notes can become authoritative without a
warning, allowing a superseded lead to post, close the room, or reuse a counter.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description Malformed fences or a quoted second block can make the current state appear to grant the lease to a superseded lead. ## Fix Focus Areas - room.py[553-554] - room.py[839-850] - room.py[941-965] ## Recommended Fix Require one canonical machine block in the expected position, with a correctly closed fence and only valid body lines.
